title: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: Queen's timeless masterpiece arranged for two hands (Grand Staff) in the original key of Bb major. Includes the legendary piano intro vamp and Freddie's vocal ballad melody.
generalTip: Play with both hands! Left hand plays the supporting bass roots while the right hand plays the iconic piano vamp and vocal melody. Key of Bb (Bb and Eb).

sections.label: The Iconic Piano Intro Vamp
tips: 👑 Freddie Mercury's legendary piano intro in the original key of Bb major!
🎹 Left hand: Resonant bass notes (Bb2 -> F2 -> G2 -> C3 -> F2) right on the Casio keyboard
👆 Right hand: Freddie's 4-chord piano vamp: Bb (F-Bb-D) -> F (F-A-C) -> Gm (G-Bb-D) -> C7 into F

sections.label: "Mama, just killed a man"
tips: 🎤 Freddie's iconic vocal enters: "Mama, just killed a man"
👆 Right hand: F steps up to G on "just", then down to Eb and D on "killed a man"
🎹 Left hand: Steady root bass accompaniment (Bb -> Gm -> Cm -> F -> Bb)

sections.label: "Life had just begun"
tips: 🕊️ "Mama, life had just begun, but now I've gone and thrown it all away"
👆 Right hand: F D F leaps up to high Bb, then four repeated Bb notes into high C
🎹 Left hand: Supportive bass walk Bb -> Gm -> Cm -> F
